title: Signature Duo 44 · Muscle Hourglass × Muscle Hourglass · Tenmoku × Irezumi Peony · Marble Atrium
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, one facing the camera and one turned away, showing the same strong hourglass figure from the front and from behind.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — late 30s, long voluminous curls with gold combs. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look. Body Art: Full body tenmoku black glaze painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. Deep glossy black glaze scattered with dense silvery oil-spot flecks and streaks of iridescent blue hare's-fur lines. The silver flecks and blue streaks wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — mid 30s, long glossy black waves, pulled over one shoulder so the back is uncovered. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white swirling wave ground with vivid vermilion, pink, gold, and jade green botan peony vines, one continuous design flowing diagonally across the torso. The peony vines wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. A large continuous design spreads across the whole back and over the hips. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a glamour pose, wide stance with a strong hip shift, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body, no flexing. The right woman — standing with her back three-quarters to the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a warm smile, one arm hanging away from the body, the painted broad back, cinched waist, and wide hips fully visible.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high gold mirror-chrome platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high pink lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A vast bright white marble atrium with a glass skylight, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft daylight from above carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making every silver fleck sparkle on the left and making the glossy colors gleam on the right, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
